title: P1-V1 Lesional
characteristics_ch1_2: disease state: Baseline Lesional Psoriasis Skin
extract_protocol_ch1_1: Skin biopsies were separated into dermis and epidermis. Single cell dissociation was performed. An equal number of dermis and epidermis cells were collected for analysis.
extract_protocol_ch1_2: Libraries were prepared using the Chromium 10X Single Cell 3' reagent Kit v2, according to the manufacturer's instructions
data_processing_1: Sequencing output files were demultiplexed and coverted to fastq files using Cell Ranger v4.0.0 to v6.1.1 (10X genomics).
data_processing_2: Cell Ranger was used to align demultiplexed reads to the reference genome, barcode counting, UMI counting and estimate the number of cells.
data_processing_4: Supplementary files format and content: For each sample there are three associated files: tab-seperated values file containing barcdoes, tab-separated file containing annotated genes (features), matrix file containing UMI counts and indices for the barcode and gene tsv files
